financial_fact: Sterling already soft on the crisis build-up
note: Pegged at ~$2.80 under Bretton Woods; pressure shows in reserves, not the rate

event: Anglo-French paratroops land at Port Said
financial_fact: Run on sterling intensifies; heavy reserve loss
note: [VERIFY] UK gold/dollar reserves fell ~$279m in Nov 1956, ~15% in a month, toward the ~$2bn danger line

financial_fact: US (Treasury Sec. Humphrey) blocks UK access to IMF drawing and support until a ceasefire+withdrawal
note: [VERIFY] Eden/Macmillan attribute the climbdown substantially to the sterling run and US refusal to help

financial_fact: US lifts the block once withdrawal is committed
note: Finance turned back ON as the reward for compliance

financial_fact: UK draws ~$561m from the IMF + arranges a ~$739m standby (~$1.3bn); Ex-Im line and US oil made available
note: [VERIFY vs IMF history (Boughton) / Kunz, The Economic Diplomacy of the Suez Crisis]
